hero.title: Shop, book and sell. All local.
hero.lead: Order from shops near you, book a salon or spa in seconds, and pay with KHQR or cash. Run a business? Sell online and at the counter from one app.
hero.setupNote: Set up in 2 minutes · no monthly fee

customers.title: Everything near you, in one app
customers.lead: Browse by category, see who's open now and how far they are.

find.title: Find it nearby
find.body: Search or browse. Prices, delivery time and distance are shown up front, with no surprises at checkout.

order.title: Order or book
order.body: Delivery, pickup, or pick a time with your favourite stylist. Free cancellation up to 2 hours before.

pay.title: Pay how you like
pay.body: KHQR from any Cambodian bank app, card, or cash. Track your rider live until it arrives.

business.title: Run your shop from one app, online and at the counter
business.lead: One stock count, one sales report, one place for orders, bookings and payments.

pos.title: POS for the counter
pos.body: Scan, take USD or riel, and get change worked out as dollars plus riel.

online.title: Online orders
online.body: Accept, pack with a checklist, hand to a rider. Customers track it live.

stock.title: One stock count
stock.body: Scan to receive stock. Counter and online sales come off the same number.

options.title: Products with options
options.body: Colours, sizes, storage. Each with its own price, SKU and barcode.

calendar.title: Calendar for your team
calendar.body: A column per stylist. Drag to move a booking, with clash warnings.

noShows.title: Fewer no-shows
noShows.body: SMS reminders, deposits on request, and a no-show history for each client.

checkout.title: Checkout & tips
checkout.body: Add products, discounts and tips that go straight to the stylist.

clients.title: Clients that come back
clients.body: Notes, visit history, and a list of who hasn't returned lately.

pricing.title: Free to start. Pay only when you sell online.

included.posFree: Counter (POS) sales are free, cash or KHQR

included.tools: Orders, bookings, stock, staff and reports included
included.cancel: Cancel any time. Your data is yours to export

calc.title: What would I pay?
calc.note: Example only. Delivery fees are paid by the customer. Payouts reach your KHQR account {days, plural, =0 {the same day as delivery} one {the day after delivery} other {# days after delivery}}.

open.title: Open your shop in 3 steps
open.lead: About 2 minutes. Your shop opens right away. Payouts start once we check your ID.

business.title: Tell us your business
business.body: Products or bookings, name and category.

khqr.title: Get paid with KHQR
khqr.body: Your Bakong ID and one photo of your ID card.

registered.q: Do I need a registered business?
registered.a: No. Individual sellers (market stalls, home businesses, freelancers) can start with just an ID photo, up to {limit} a month in online sales. Registered businesses have no limit.

paid.a: Customers pay by KHQR, card or cash. Online payments go to your Bakong ID {days, plural, =0 {the same day as delivery} one {the day after delivery} other {# days after delivery}}. Cash on delivery is collected by the rider and returned within 24 hours.

counter.q: Can I use it only at my counter?
counter.a: Yes. The POS works without selling online, and counter sales are free. Turn on online orders whenever you are ready.

delivery.a: VirtualBiz riders collect from your shop, or use your own delivery. Customers can also pick up. Delivery fees are paid by the customer, and you can offer free delivery above an amount you choose.

staff.a: Yes. Invite staff by phone number as Manager or Staff. Staff can use the POS or their own calendar without seeing payouts or settings.

khmer.a: Khmer and English are both supported. Change the language from the top of any page.

cta.title: Your neighbourhood, one tap away
cta.body: Shop and book as a customer, or open your shop today. Same account for both.
